Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. The following additional/amended eligibility, technical, warranty, training, presentation/demonstr ation, and service-support conditions shall be incorporated into the Bid Document. These conditions s hall form an integral part of the Tender Document and shall be treated as mandatory requirements. 1. Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the Bidder The bidder shall have a minimum average annual turnover of INR 12 Lakh (Rupees Twelve Lakh o nly) during the last three financial years. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of the above requirement, such as: Audited financial statements; Balance sheets; Profit and Loss Statements; and/or A turnover certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant. The submitted documents shall clearly establish compliance with the prescribed minimum average annual turnover requirement. 2. Minimum Average Annual Turnover of the OEM The Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) shall have a minimum average annual turnover of INR 1 Core (Rupees One Core only) during the last three financial years. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in support of the OEM's turnover requirement, such as: Audited financial statements; Balance sheets; Profit and Loss Statements; and/or A turnover certificate issued by a Chartered Accountant. The bidder shall be responsible for ensuring that adequate documentary evidence of the OEM's financial c apability is submitted along with the technical bid. 3. Past Experience The bidder and/or the OEM shall have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in the supply, installa tion, commissioning, operation support, maintenance and/or servicing of the same or similar type of equip ment. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence demonstrating such experience, including, wherever applic able: Purchase Orders; Supply Orders; Installation and Commissioning Certificates; Performance Certificates; Work Orders; Completion Certificates; and/or Other relevant documentary evidence acceptable to the Purchaser. The Purchaser reserves the right to verify the submitted experience credentials from the concerned end us ers, institutions, organizations, or other relevant sources. 4. Warranty The supplied equipment shall be covered by a comprehensive warranty for a period of five (5) year s from the date of successful installation and commissioning of the complete system. The comprehensive warranty shall cover, without any additional cost to the Purchaser, all items and services necessary to keep the equipment in proper working condition, including but not limited to: All parts and components of the equipment; Computer, control system and associated hardware; Data-acquisition system and associated hardware; Software and software-related functionality supplied with the equipment; Accessories supplied as part of the system; Labour and service charges;

Repairs and troubleshooting; Replacement of defective, failed, damaged or non-performing components; and Any other item, component, consumable or service required to maintain the supplied system in pro per working condition during the warranty period, wherever such item is covered under the compre hensive warranty. The bidder/OEM shall ensure timely rectification of defects and replacement of defective or failed components throughout the warranty period. No additional charges shall be payable by the Purchaser for warranty-related repair, service, labour, repla cement or troubleshooting covered under the comprehensive warranty. 5. Mandatory Presentation/Demonstration before Opening of Financial Bid A presentation and/or demonstration shall be mandatory for all technically qualified bidders b efore opening of the financial bids. Each technically qualified bidder shall give a detailed presentation and/or demonstration covering, at a mi nimum, the following: Technical specifications and compliance with all tender requirements; Working principle and operation of the equipment; Major features and capabilities of the system; Computer-controlled operation; Data acquisition and data-logging facility; Calibration procedure and measurement accuracy; Software features and data-analysis capabilities; Installation and commissioning methodology; Training arrangements; After-sales service and technical support; Warranty provisions; and Service-support arrangements. The presentation/demonstration shall be evaluated by the Purchaser/Technical Evaluation Committee . The bidder shall demonstrate that the offered equipment is capable of meeting the technical and functiona l requirements specified in the tender. Only those bidders who successfully complete the required presentation/demonstration and ar e found technically compliant with the tender requirements shall be considered for opening of their financial bids. The decision of the Purchaser/Technical Evaluation Committee regarding technical compliance and satisfac tory completion of the presentation/demonstration shall be final, subject to the provisions of the applicable procurement rules. 6. Training of Technical Personnel at OEM's Factory/Premises

As the Purchaser intends to establish and operate the laboratory in accordance with the requirements of N ABL accreditation, the bidder/OEM shall arrange suitable technical training for the technical professionals/operators nominated by the Purchaser at the OEM's own factory/premises or authorized training facility, as applicable. The training shall be designed to ensure competent operation, measurement, data handling, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting of the supplied equipment. The training shall cover, at a minimum: Operation and handling of the equipment; Computer-controlled operation; Data acquisition and data logging; Software operation and data analysis; Calibration and measurement procedures; Routine maintenance; Troubleshooting and fault diagnosis; Safety precautions; and Good laboratory and equipment operating practices. Where applicable, the training shall also include aspects relevant to measurement traceability, calibra tion records, data integrity, equipment verification and proper documentation, so as to support t he Purchaser's laboratory quality-management requirements and preparation for NABL accreditation. The bidder shall clearly indicate in the technical bid: Proposed training schedule; Duration of training; Number of personnel to be trained; Training location; Scope and contents of training; Name/designation or qualification of proposed trainers, wherever available; and Whether a training/completion certificate will be provided. The training shall be conducted by suitably qualified and competent personnel of the OEM or its d uly authorized technical personnel. The bidder/OEM shall bear all costs associated with providing the stipulated training, unless otherwise spe cified elsewhere in the Tender Document. 1.1.Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): An amount of Rs. 50,000 (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) (refundable) in the form of Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’s Cheque (BC) paid in favour of “IN DIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur must be submitted with the bid. An y bid without EMD will summarily be rejected. No interest is payable on EMD. EMD will be refunded to the unsuccessful bidder after finalization of the bidding process stage by stage i.e. Technical evaluation and Fi nancial evaluation. The EMD of the vendor awarded the contract may be treated as part of security deposit towards Performance Guarantee. EMD shall be forfeited if the selected vendor after award of the contract f ails to execute the same. Bidders has to upload scanned copy/proof of the Demand Draft (DD)/ Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR)/ Banker’ s Cheque (BC)aIong with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the buyer at below mentioned addr ess within S days of Bid End date/Bid Opening date. To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur

Kharagpur – 721302. 1.2. Payment Terms: i. 90% payment of the total contract shall be made after receipt of stores in good order a nd condition, successful installation and demonstration, thereafter certification of your bill by the concerned Head of the Department/ Centers/Schools/Units. ii. Balance 10% payment of the contract value may be released against submission of Per formance Security to the tune of 3% of the total Contract Value or on completion of war ranty period. 1.3. Performance Security: Performance Security may be submitted in the form of Demand Draft/ Fixe d Deposit Receipt/ Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) from any of the commercial banks in India and paid in favour of “INDIAN INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY KHARAGPUR”, payable at Kharagpur to the tune of 3% of the total contract value. The PBG shall be valid for the period of warranty period plus 60 days. The p erformance security will be forfeited and credited to the procuring Entity’s account in the event of breach of contract by the contractor. The address for submission of hard copy of the Security Deposit is as follows : To The Assistant Registrar Stores and Purchase Section Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur Kharagpur – 721302. 1.4. Jurisdiction: All questions, disputes, or differences arising under, out of or in connection with the co ntract, if concluded, shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction at the place from which the acceptance of Tender is issued i.e. Jurisdiction of KOLKATA HIGH COURT. Acceptance to this effect is also necessary at th e time of opening of Technical Bid. Important Note: Bidders should submit the following certificates as per Annexures 1. Declaration of Local Content as per Annexure-I 2. Certificate for Land Border Sharing as per Annexure –II; and 3. Undertaking regarding Blacklisting/Non-debarment as per Annexure-III The above-mentioned Annexures are available through Google through Google Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DvPQWyOO_81KxfObLiWqaVtCyeSASWzp/view?usp=sharing . 15.
